title: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'values[text_shadow_color]' parameter in…
description: A WordPress plugin is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via the 'values[text_shadow_color]' parameter in all versions up to and including 9.1. The vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts. The sanitization method used (wp_kses_post) fails to remove the payload because it is stored as URL-encoded JSON inside a shortcode attribute, which bypasses HTML tag-based filtering. This results in script execution when a user views the injected page.
